verdict.rationale: vLLM is an inference engine, not an assistant-builder, but it does provide building blocks for task-specialized serving: multi-LoRA adapters for task-tuned variants, tool calling with tool_choice control, structured outputs, and reasoning parsers, all exposed through an OpenAI-compatible API. Assembling these into actual 'custom assistants' needs an external application layer. Missing for 10: any first-class assistant/persona configuration, saved per-task instructions or assistant objects, a UI or workflow for creating assistants, and hands-on evidence of the capability in use.
